slides.title: THE DIFFERENCE
slides.note: The mean is pulled by extreme values. The median is resistant to them.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 1
slides.problem: Find the mean and median of 2, 4, 6, 8, 10.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 2
slides.problem: Find the mean and median of 3, 4, 5, 6, 92.

slides.title: WATCH OUT
slides.wrong: Use the mean for skewed data like incomes or house prices
points: With outliers or skew, report the median.
For an even count, the median is the average of the two middle values. Sort first.

pageTitle: Mean vs Median: When to Use Each
description: Learn when to use the mean or the median with two worked examples and the most common mistakes.
